<!--
FDIC-BRC / JFQA revision v2: anticipation evidence.
§1 Pre-adoption insured-brokered ramp (k in [-3,-1]) on FUTURE CECL Adj.
§2 CECL capital phase-in election (RCOAJJ29) by treatment; ramp x elector.
§3 RateWatch weekly posted-rate event study around 2023: SVB week (Mar 10)
   vs first public Day-One disclosures (Call Reports posted ~May 1).
   2023Q1-adopter cohort only, so event dates align in calendar time.
§4 Posted-rate DiD with the post period split: stress window (Mar 10-Apr 30)
   vs post-publication (May 1 onward). Products: 12MCD10K, 12MCD100K, SAV2.5K.
Inputs: panel_smallbank (fallback), bank_treatment_20260806.csv,
        ratewatch_bankweek_20260806.csv.
-->

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)

source(here::here("code", "_common.R"))
source(here::here("tracks", "fdic-brc-jfqa-aug2026", "code", "_track_common.R"))

save_figures <- TRUE
save_tables  <- TRUE

panel <- readRDS(latest_track_file("panel_smallbank"))
setDT(panel)
treat <- fread(file.path(TRACK_DATA, "bank_treatment_20260806.csv"))
rw <- fread(file.path(TRACK_DATA, "ratewatch_bankweek_20260806.csv"))

dict_a <- c(covariate_labels_dict,
            "apy" = "Posted APY (\\%)",
            "d_brokered_ins" = "$\\Delta$ Ins. Brokered/Assets ($k{=}{-}4$ to $-1$)",
            "elect_phasein" = "Phase-In Elected",
            "cecl_equity:elect_phasein" = "CECL Adj x Phase-In",
            "post_stress" = "Stress window (Mar 10--Apr 30)",
            "post_pub" = "Post-publication (May 1--)",
            "post_stress:high_cecl_equity" = "Stress x High CECL",
            "high_cecl_equity:post_stress" = "Stress x High CECL",
            "post_pub:high_cecl_equity" = "Post-publication x High CECL",
            "high_cecl_equity:post_pub" = "Post-publication x High CECL",
            "week_f" = "Week",
            "(Intercept)" = "Constant")
```

## §1 Pre-adoption insured-brokered ramp on future CECL Adj

```{r}
# Cross-section: change in insured brokered/assets from k=-4 to k=-1 regressed
# on the future (still undisclosed) Day-One adjustment. Expected positive.
pr <- panel[qtrs_since %in% c(-4L, -1L),
            .(ID_RSSD, qtrs_since, brokered_ins_assets,
              log_total_assets_l1, equity_assets_l1)]
pr_w <- dcast(pr, ID_RSSD ~ qtrs_since, value.var = "brokered_ins_assets")
setnames(pr_w, c("-4", "-1"), c("bi_m4", "bi_m1"))
pr_w[, d_brokered_ins := bi_m1 - bi_m4]
pr_w[treat, on = "ID_RSSD",
     `:=`(cecl_equity = i.cecl_equity, high_cecl_equity = i.high_cecl_equity)]
ctrl <- panel[qtrs_since == -4L, .(ID_RSSD, log_total_assets_l1, equity_assets_l1)]
pr_w[ctrl, on = "ID_RSSD",
     `:=`(log_total_assets_l1 = i.log_total_assets_l1,
          equity_assets_l1 = i.equity_assets_l1)]

r1 <- list(
  feols(d_brokered_ins ~ cecl_equity, data = pr_w, vcov = "hetero"),
  feols(d_brokered_ins ~ high_cecl_equity, data = pr_w, vcov = "hetero"),
  feols(d_brokered_ins ~ cecl_equity + log_total_assets_l1 + equity_assets_l1,
        data = pr_w, vcov = "hetero"),
  feols(d_brokered_ins ~ high_cecl_equity + log_total_assets_l1 + equity_assets_l1,
        data = pr_w, vcov = "hetero")
)
cat("\n================ §1 PRE-RAMP ON FUTURE CHARGE ================\n")
etable(r1, dict = dict_a)
export_track_tbl(r1, "tbl_anticipation_preramp", dict_a)
```

## §2 Phase-in election

```{r}
treat[, elect_phasein := as.integer(cecl_transition_election %in% c(1, 2))]
cat("\n================ §2 PHASE-IN ELECTION ================\n")
cat("Election rate by High CECL:\n")
print(treat[, .(share_elect = mean(elect_phasein), .N), by = high_cecl_equity])
cat("Mean CECL Adj by election:\n")
print(treat[, .(mean_cecl = mean(cecl_equity), median_cecl = median(cecl_equity), .N),
            by = elect_phasein])

pr_w[treat, on = "ID_RSSD", elect_phasein := i.elect_phasein]
r2 <- list(
  feols(elect_phasein ~ cecl_equity, data = treat, vcov = "hetero"),
  feols(elect_phasein ~ high_cecl_equity, data = treat, vcov = "hetero"),
  feols(d_brokered_ins ~ elect_phasein + log_total_assets_l1 + equity_assets_l1,
        data = pr_w, vcov = "hetero"),
  feols(d_brokered_ins ~ cecl_equity * elect_phasein + log_total_assets_l1 +
          equity_assets_l1, data = pr_w, vcov = "hetero")
)
etable(r2, dict = dict_a)
export_track_tbl(r2, "tbl_anticipation_election", dict_a)

# Combined single anticipation table for the paper:
# (1)-(2) pre-adoption insured-brokered ramp on the future charge;
# (3) LPM of phase-in election on the charge; (4) ramp on election.
r_ant <- list(
  r1[[3]], r1[[4]], r2[[1]], r2[[3]]
)
export_track_tbl(r_ant, "tbl_anticipation", dict_a)
```

## §3 RateWatch weekly event study around 2023 (2023Q1 cohort)

```{r}
main_cohort <- treat[adopt_qtr == as.Date("2023-03-31")]
rw[, week := as.Date(cut(week_date, "week"))]  # Monday of survey week
rww <- rw[, .(apy = mean(apy)), by = .(ID_RSSD, week, product)]
rww <- rww[main_cohort, on = "ID_RSSD", nomatch = NULL]
rww <- rww[week >= as.Date("2022-07-01") & week <= as.Date("2024-04-30")]

SVB_DATE <- as.Date("2023-03-10")
PUB_DATE <- as.Date("2023-05-01")
REF_WEEK <- as.Date("2023-03-06")  # last week beginning before the SVB failure

cd <- rww[product == "12MCD10K"]
cd[, week_f := factor(week)]
m3 <- feols(apy ~ i(week_f, high_cecl_equity, ref = as.character(REF_WEEK)) |
              ID_RSSD + week_f, data = cd, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)

cf <- coef(m3); sev <- se(m3)
idx <- grepl("^week_f::", names(cf))
pd <- data.table(
  week = as.Date(sub("^week_f::(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}):high_cecl_equity$", "\\1",
                     names(cf)[idx])),
  est = cf[idx], se = sev[idx]
)
pd <- rbind(pd, data.table(week = REF_WEEK, est = 0, se = 0))
setorder(pd, week)
pd[, `:=`(lo90 = est - CI_Z * se, hi90 = est + CI_Z * se)]

p <- ggplot(pd, aes(x = week, y = est)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = accent_gray, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.numeric(SVB_DATE), color = negative_red,
             linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.numeric(PUB_DATE), color = "darkred",
             linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "solid") +
  annotate("text", x = SVB_DATE - 10, y = Inf, label = "SVB failure",
           color = negative_red, vjust = 1.5, hjust = 1, size = 2.8) +
  annotate("text", x = PUB_DATE + 10, y = Inf, label = "Day-One disclosures public",
           color = "darkred", vjust = 1.5, hjust = 0, size = 2.8) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo90, ymax = hi90), fill = primary_blue, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(color = primary_blue, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(color = primary_blue, size = 1.1) +
  theme_custom() +
  labs(x = "Week", y = "Coefficient (posted 12-month CD APY, pp)")
print(p)
save_track_fig(p, "fig_rw_weekly_es", width = 6.5, height = 3.2)
```

## §4 Posted-rate DiD: stress window vs post-publication

```{r}
rww[, post_stress := as.integer(week >= SVB_DATE & week < PUB_DATE)]
rww[, post_pub    := as.integer(week >= PUB_DATE)]

r4 <- list()
for (prd in c("12MCD10K", "12MCD100K", "SAV2.5K")) {
  d <- rww[product == prd]
  d[, week_f := factor(week)]
  r4[[prd]] <- feols(apy ~ post_stress * high_cecl_equity +
                       post_pub * high_cecl_equity | ID_RSSD + week_f,
                     data = d, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
}
cat("\n================ §4 POSTED-RATE DiD (stress vs publication) ================\n")
etable(r4, dict = dict_a,
       order = c("Post-publication x High CECL", "Stress x High CECL"))
export_track_tbl(r4, "tbl_rw_did", dict_a,
                 order = c("Post-publication x High CECL", "Stress x High CECL"))

# Continuous-treatment variant for the retail CD
d <- rww[product == "12MCD10K"]
d[, week_f := factor(week)]
r4c <- feols(apy ~ post_stress * cecl_equity + post_pub * cecl_equity |
               ID_RSSD + week_f, data = d, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
print(summary(r4c))

cat("\n================ DIAGNOSTICS ================\n")
cat("Pre-ramp cross-section N:", nrow(pr_w[!is.na(d_brokered_ins) & !is.na(cecl_equity)]), "\n")
cat("RateWatch weekly panel: banks", uniqueN(rww$ID_RSSD),
    "| weeks", uniqueN(rww$week), "| rows", nrow(rww), "\n")
cat("Mean APY 12MCD10K by period (high vs low CECL):\n")
print(rww[product == "12MCD10K",
          .(mean_apy = round(mean(apy), 3)),
          by = .(high_cecl_equity,
                 period = fifelse(post_pub == 1, "post-pub",
                                  fifelse(post_stress == 1, "stress", "pre")))][
            order(period, high_cecl_equity)])
```
